name: Achall

attributes.attribute: died of grief at her brother's end

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Achall is an Irish heroine. A hill east of Tara, the seat of kings, holds her name. She was a princess of Ulster. She died of grief when Conall Cernach slew her brother Erc. Such love for her brother placed her among the six women of Ireland known for loyalty.
